• Fall 2027 admissions closed; restart expected Fall 2028, not guaranteed.

number-theory adviser. Delaware Fall 2027 application suspension remains governed by the base dossier.

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Number theory
Robert Coulter
Finite fields and low-differential-uniformity functions, with applications to projective geometry, semifields,
coding and cryptography; this is a finite-field/discrete-algebra fit rather than a broad arithmetic-geometry
group. [faculty1] [faculty1a]
Professor and Director of Graduate Programs. Future-cycle planning only: department is not admitting Fall 2027.
Research evidence: 2025 · Algorithms for computing the permutation resemblance of functions over finite groups
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Gregory Michajlyszyn
Algebraic number theory and ramification in p-adic fields according to current Delaware biography. Verified
older paper is in operator theory, so it does not independently support the current number-theory
specialization. [faculty3] [gapc12] [gapc13] [gapc14] [gapc15]
Department roster says Temporary Assistant Professor; individual profile simplifies this to Assistant Professor. Independent
long-term doctoral supervision is unverified.
Research evidence: 2020 · Explicit Krein resolvent identities for singular Sturm-Liouville operators with applications to Bessel
operators
Primary journal author index dates publication December 2020; five authors including Michajlyszyn. No newer primary
number-theory paper or dissertation verified.
Evidence history and corrections (earlier statements may be superseded)
 Earlier interests: Official profile identifies algebraic number theory, particularly ramification in p-adic fields. No recent
number-theory paper metadata was located after official profile and author searches; detailed fit is not paper-verified.
Earlier appointment: Assistant Professor per current university profile; doctoral-supervision authorization unconfirmed. No
Fall 2027 admission.
Evidence qualifications
Temporary appointment requires separate supervision confirmation; do not present as confirmed permanent number-theory
adviser. Delaware Fall 2027 application suspension remains governed by the base dossier.
